category.name: Content Control
category.preferred_workflow: Generate a minimal in-memory DOCX sample (or folder of samples), locate or create the appropriate parent node, instantiate a StructuredDocumentTag with a valid SdtType and MarkupLevel, populate its child nodes, insert it using InsertNode or AppendChild, apply any required XML mapping or styling, and finally save the document in the desired format.

strict_api_bans: Do not reference helper methods, properties, or overloads that are not part of the Aspose.Words SDK.
Do not treat a generic Node as a StructuredDocumentTag unless it was created as such.
canonical_patterns: Create StructuredDocumentTag instances directly with the constructor (doc, SdtType, MarkupLevel) and add child runs, paragraphs, tables, or shapes as needed.
Use Aspose.Drawing for image generation and Newtonsoft.Json for JSON handling; avoid System.Drawing and undocumented JSON utilities.
nullable_warning_prevention: Initialize all non-nullable reference-type members (e.g., Title, Tag) when constructing a control.
Declare variables as nullable when a lookup may return null and guard them with explicit null checks before dereferencing.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails because methods such as StartStructuredDocumentTag or InsertStructuredDocumentTag do not exist.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code assumes convenience APIs that are not provided by Aspose.Words.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Instantiate StructuredDocumentTag directly and insert it with DocumentBuilder.InsertNode or Node.AppendChild.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the official API reference for StructuredDocumentTag constructors and insertion methods before writing helper wrappers.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime error "Cannot insert a node of this type at this location" is thrown when adding a control.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The control's MarkupLevel does not match the target container (e.g., inserting an inline SDT into a HeaderFooter collection).
common_failure_patterns.fix: Select a parent node that matches the control's MarkupLevel: use Paragraph or Run for Inline, and Header/Footer or Body for Block.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Validate the parent node type with Node.NodeType before calling InsertNode or AppendChild.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compiler reports ambiguous references between Aspose.Drawing.Font and Aspose.Words.Font, or between Color types.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Both Aspose.Drawing and Aspose.Words define types with identical names and the code does not qualify them.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Fully qualify the type (e.g., Aspose.Drawing.Font) or add an alias using directive.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Prefer explicit namespace prefixes for types that exist in multiple Aspose assemblies.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0117 errors indicate that SdtType.DateTime or similar members are missing.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The version of Aspose.Words used does not expose dedicated date-time SDT types.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use a plain-text StructuredDocumentTag and populate it with a formatted date string.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Check the SDK release notes for available SdtType values and avoid hard-coding members that may be removed.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS1501 errors show that no InsertOleObject overload matches the supplied argument list.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code passes a file path string where a Stream is required, and includes parameters that do not exist.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Open the OLE file as a FileStream and call InsertOleObject(stream, displayName, isIcon, iconStream) with the correct signatures.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Reference the method signature in the Aspose.Words documentation and pass only the supported parameters.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0117 errors occur because SaveFormat.Xml or SaveFormat.OpenXml are not defined.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The SDK provides SaveFormat.Docx, Html, Pdf, etc., but not an XML constant.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Save the document using SaveFormat.Docx or Html and, if raw XML is needed, use doc.Save(stream, SaveOptions.CreateSaveOptions(SaveFormat.OpenXml)).
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Use only the SaveFormat members listed in the official API reference.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS1503 errors indicate that a string is being passed where a CustomXmlPart instance is required.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code attempts to assign raw XML text directly to a property expecting a CustomXmlPart object.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Create the part with doc.CustomXmlParts.Add(id, xmlString) and then use the returned CustomXmlPart for mapping.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always obtain a CustomXmlPart via the Add method before using it in XmlMapping.SetMapping.

narrative.overview: The Content Control category demonstrates how to manipulate Aspose.Words StructuredDocumentTag objects for a variety of scenarios, including plain-text, picture, date, OLE, hyperlink, repeating-section, dropdown, and custom XML-mapped controls. The verified examples show end-to-end implementations that create sample inputs, configure supported properties, and persist the results without relying on nonexistent APIs.
narrative.purpose: Provide an AI coding assistant with clear guidance and reusable patterns for creating, configuring, and validating content controls in Word documents using only the official Aspose.Words API surface.
validation_priorities: Verify that every StructuredDocumentTag uses a supported SdtType enum value.
Confirm that insertion points are compatible with the control's MarkupLevel (inline vs. block).
Ensure that any XML mapping references a valid CustomXmlPart and XPath expression.
maintenance_notes: Review the Aspose.Words release notes quarterly and update example code whenever new SdtType values or insertion APIs are added or deprecated.
